description: Matching Qwen3ForCausalLM dispatch does not make the indexed FP8 variants loadable by the existing tensor loader.
trigger: Load a stored F8_E4M3 projection from any of the six inspected Qwen3 FP8 configurations.
expected_behavior: FP8 compatibility would require decoding the stored dtype and applying its block scales, or rejecting that format before ordinary-weight loading.
actual_behavior: Linear selects the ordinary .weight path, whose get_tensor call reaches convert_dtype. That function rejects F8_E4M3 as an unknown dtype. The inspected FP8 headers also contain projection weight_scale_inv tensors that this loading path never reads. This is an existing format limitation exposed by the newly recognized architecture, not evidence that the commit promised FP8 support.

verification.description: Inspected first-layer FP8 weights and scale tensors for all six sizes, Linear’s loading choice, and both active convert_dtype call sites in get_tensor and list_tensors.
verification.limits: No checkpoint payload was loaded. Header inspection was representative rather than exhaustive across FP8 shards.

introductions.rationale: Introduction of Qwen3 dispatch exposes this checkpoint compatibility boundary; not introduction of the pre-existing generic dtype restriction.
